question: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar described Directive Principles of State Policy as ________ of the Indian constitution.

options.text: The most precious part of the constitution
a novel feature of the constitution

solution:
The correct answer is __**a novel feature of the constitution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, the principal architect of the Indian Constitution, described the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) as a novel feature of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The DPSPs are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government and are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• They are enshrined in Part IV of the Constitution, covering Articles 36 to 51.</li&
